text: Marnuck vs. Prone is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Marnuck fighting a Prone. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Ultimate Price.
Man's Best Friend is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime at the Water Purification Plant in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Frye and Cross.

The Marnuck Hunter (Japanese: , Marunāku Hantā) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Marnuck and can be found at level 45 at Sylvalum's Secluded Lava Lake. It must be defeated during Professorial. It drops the Gray Keycard which is needed to free Professor B.

Maple Oil are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the weak points of black Ciniculas in Cauldros. They are components in X-XX Overdrive Count Up and Overdrive.EXTEND augments. Two units are required for Sweet Maple Goodness.

Marnuck A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the standard Marnuck trooper variant equipped with brown weapons and light armor. It can be obtained from silver drops from Gadaf, the Pulverizer in Oblivia.

Marnuck B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the standard Marnuck trooper variant equipped with coppery and green weapons and light armor. It can be obtained from silver drops from Daril, the Eradicator in Primordia.

Marnuck Elite A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts an elite Marnuck trooper variant wearing a white heavy armor. It can be obtained from silver drops from Sadar, the Unhinged in Sylvalum.
Marnuck Elite B is a Holofigure in . It depicts an elite Marnuck trooper variant wearing a red heavy armor. It can be obtained from silver drops from Duran, the Draconian in Cauldros.

Marnuck Elite C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts an elite Marnuck trooper variant wearing a white and red heavy armor. It can be obtained from silver drops from Ahama, the Covetous in Sylvalum.

Marnuck Elite D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts an elite Marnuck trooper variant wearing a golden heavy armor. It can be obtained from silver drops from the Berserk Marnuck in Cauldros.

Ma-non Capsule Pod is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts one of the storage pods used in the Ma-non Ship, with a Ma-non sitting on top. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Pip-Squeak.

Make the First Move! is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.7, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Vivohasts. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Marnuck Trap is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.14, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twelve Marnucks. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Marnuck Vans are Mission Exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Marnucks and can be found at level 28 on Primordia's East Gate Plain during route B of Blitzkrieg. They are part of an onslaught of enemies that must be defended against for three minutes.

|-|XR130 Model= |-|XR140 Model= |-|R150 Model= |-|XR160 Model= |-|XXR140 Model= |-|XXR160 Model= Machine Guns are sidearms for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Creed Revolver type Galdrs, Petramands or Vigents.
The Maelstrom Interior (Japanese: , Uzushio Sennai) is a landmark in . It is located in the C.S.E.V. Maelstrom.
The Maelstrom Deck (Japanese: , Uzushio Kanpan) is a landmark in . It is located on the C.S.E.V. Maelstrom.
Mamalu is an NPC in . Mamalu is a Nopon who can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. Mamalu runs a shop called Mamalu's Core Store.

Mamalu's Core Store (Japanese: , Ashisutokoa Maruru) is a shop in . It is run by Mamalu and can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. It does not sell Aux Cores, but Aux Cores can be refined here, at the cost of specific Collectibles.
Mach Straight Punch (Japanese: , Mahhasutorēto, Lit. "Mach Straight") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Knuckle Claws.
Marine Stir-Fries are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Fishy Fishy in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of Wulfric's favorite Pouch Items.
The Main Ventilation Duct (Japanese: , Chūō Kankidakuto) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
The Maluria Deeds are a Store Deed key item in . They can be purchased from Maluria Antiques in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Margia's Odds & Ends is a shop in . It is run by Kassa and can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Maluria Antiques is a shop in . It is run by Girdys and can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Art.
Mamanji is an NPC in . Mamanji is a Nopon who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Mamanji runs a shop called Hobby Trappers specialized in Board Games.

Malicious Dimitri (Japanese: , Onnen no Reddokoa) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Guldo family and can be found at level 57 inside the Evacuation Center next to Great Wall Tunnel No. 8 in the Land of Morytha. It must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 4 "Carnage" and Perun's level 5 "Silent Spear" Battle Skills.

Machine-Gun Julio (Japanese: , Kikanjū no Pīto) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Ansel family and can be found at level 53 around the Morytha Falls at the Cliffs of Morytha. His Tombstone is located southwest of Morytha Falls. He must be defeated to unlock Dromarch's level 5 Aqua Wave, Zenobia's level 4 Diabolic Zephyr, Aegaeon's level 5 Midnight Mist, and Sever's level 5 Engrave. Machine-Gun Julio has an enhancement that boosts his Break resistance by 30%.
Mahi Pippitos (Japanese: , Mahha Pipitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family and can be found at level 38-45 on the Upper Level - Right of Gormott Province.

Mahn Krabbles (Japanese: , Māchi Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family and can be found at level 1 by Salvaging on the Salvage Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. This enemy drops no items.

Mabalus Parisax (Japanese: , Mabarusu Parasu) are enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family and can be found at level 52-56 inside the Womb Hollow in the Land of Morytha. They can be summoned at level 49-51 by Werval Egg's art "Emergence".

Mabluk Aspar (Japanese: , Maburuku Angu) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family and can be found at level 49-51 underneath the Path of the Believer on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Pandoria's level 4 Electric Circus, Wulfric's level 4 Termination Blast, and Kora's level 4 Angelic Drop, and three of them to unlock T-elos's level 4 "Heartbreaker".

Mailoo Garaffas (Japanese: , Mairuzu Girafe) are enemies in . They are members of the Garaffa family and can be found at level 19-22 during the day in the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at the Cleansing Spring, Lake Varna, Farlaine Wells, Yurna the Elderwood. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Nim's level 2 "Wild Familiars".

Marauder Laias (Japanese: , Marōdā Raia) are enemies in . They are members of the Laia family, and can be found at level 56 - 58 southeast of the Ardainian Garrison and northwest of Titan Weapon Dig Site in Temperantia.

Majacan Krabbles (Japanese: , Majigen Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 43 - 47 at the Blackday Peninsula on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Mant Aries (Japanese: , Maunto Ariesu) are enemies in . They are members of the Aries family, and can be found at level 36 - 40 at the Three-Vein Crossroads on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

Magnl Caterpiles (Japanese: , Magunaru Kyapiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 40-42 in the Kingdom of Tantal, at the Amphoret Pillar on the Upper Level or at the Sacred Grove on the Lower Level. They can be summoned at level 39-41 by Nant Buloofo's art "Beast Howl". Five must be defeated to unlock Kasandra's level 3 Sentimental Burst.

Manda Moramoras (Japanese: , Mandā Moramora) are enemies in . They are members of the Moramora family and can be found in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly above Farlaine Wells at level 20-22 or in the Fonsa Myma Waters at level 26-27. They only appear during crystal squall weather.
Malignant Gorge (Japanese: , Metsu no Zangeki) is a location in . It is located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, below The Great Archway, south of Toxbloom Spring. Bonard's grave is located here.

Main Story Quests are quests in and that are important for the progression of the plot. They are accepted as the plot progresses naturally, and the plot does not progress until the current one is finished. When one is set as the active quest, the compass does not use the standard purple exclamation mark. Instead, it uses a pink icon with two exclamation marks, the same one used with any story progression.
Magmalachites are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Land of Morytha, in particular from the Collection Points inside the Decaying Titan. Two are needed to refine Fast Blade Switch VI.
Magnet Claies are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Cliffs of Morytha.

Maple Bites are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, specifically in the Agronomy collection point next to the Hot Pipe District, 1F. They can also be found in the Indoline Praetorium, in the tunnel north of the Fount of Holy Light.
Marine Chowfishes are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Marriage Bluegills are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular slightly northwest and northeast of the Ruins of Fountain Park.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Male Loinclothes (Japanese: , Otoko no Fundoshi) are accessories in . They increase damage dealt while the Driver has a female Blade engaged by up to 60%. The Male Loincloth can only be equipped exclusively by male Drivers (Rex, Tora, Vandham and Zeke). The female equivalent is the Charming Swimsuit. The DLC exclusive Enlightened Loincloth accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.
Machina Wings are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the 7th Perimeter Skyport on the World Tree.

Margot Sovereigns (Japanese: , Mirāju Roiyaru) are enemies in . They are Margot-type Sovereigns that can be found on the Lower Level of the World Tree, at level 56-58 on the bridge above Waste Store, level 58-60 inside the Control Room, level 60-62 inside the Data Processing Room, and level 62-64 in Lv. 3, Alioth. Four must be defeated to unlock Newt's level 4 Flaming Slashwave, and Vale's level 4 "Void Lance". Four must be defeated to unlock Mikhail's level 3 "Dark Mastery" and level 4 Crow Beat.
Magmund Standards (Japanese: , Magumunto Furaggu) are enemies in . They are Standards that can be found at level 41-43 on Declessa Altar Hill on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

Magnet Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by a variety of enemies, primarily in the Empire of Mor Ardain and the Kingdom of Torna, as well as given as rewards from five quests and found in several Treasure Troves. Magnet Chips share their appearance with Chain Chips, Coil Chips, and Shaft Chips. __TOC__

Manufacture Help (Japanese: , Tairyōseisan no Otetsudai) is a Merc Group mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province by talking to Nomon at Kloom Farm after completing the quest Grow, Little Vegetables!. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Botany", "Wind Mastery" and "Water Mastery" Field Skills. It is the only source of Nopopomouli collectibles, which are required for the quest A Secret Cure.
Madoline Tirkin (Japanese: , Madōrīn Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 42-44 on Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Makfur Runners (Japanese: , Makafura Rannā) are enemies in . They are members of the Skwaror family, and can be found at level 38 - 44 on Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.

The Magno Blant (Japanese: , Magunori Barando) is a quest exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Blant family, and can be found at the Sternum Arch in the Kingdom of Uraya during the quest Pest Control 1.
Malbren Salvaging is a shop in . It can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Cylinders.

Mabon is an NPC in . He is an elderly Ardainian Driver who can be found at the Tretl Windmill Plaza in the Gormott Province during the day during Tranquility. He is Vess's Driver, and the father of Antis and Noelle. In his youth, Mabon was an active adventurer with Vess by his side, and after the death of his wife, Vess acted as a mother-figure to his two children, Antis and Noelle. Mabon had a job training young Gormotti Drivers, but eventually retired when he became too old to train. In his old age, Mabon is fond of Bitter Choclit and enjoys a quiet life in Torigoth with Vess. He eventually passes away in his home alongside the new friends he has made in the party, and Vess returns to her
Mark is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found near Verde Carpentry Workshop or at the Azure Schoolhouse in the Leftherian Archipelago.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Machine Hunter (Japanese: , Mashīn Hantā) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases the damage dealt against Machines by up to 45%. Machine-type enemies belong to the following enemy species: Artifice, Bot and Sovereign. Artificial Blades like Rosa are Machine-type, however Lila is uniquely treated as a Blade-type enemy, and is therefore not targeted by this effect. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Mamumu is an NPC in . She can be found at the Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain. She gives the quest The Ties That Bind. Her daughter is Mimin.

Mabas Urchons (Japanese: , Mabasusu Unin) are enemies in . They are members of the Urchon family, and can be found at level 43-47 at the Dalnes Stone in Temperantia after Salvaging. They can also be found at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain after Salvaging during the quest Bana's Secret Treasure.

The Maiden Statue Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Shipping Lanes Closed. It enables the purchase of Singing Maiden Statues from the Maluria Antiques shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Maasti Ignas (Japanese: , Māse Igūna) are quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 18 at the Farlaine Central Pools in the Kingdom of Uraya during Gotta Start Somewhere!.
Maghillic is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He runs a shop called Martietta Trading.

Marigold in Bloom (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Inferno Wheel.
Maddock is an NPC in . He can be found at Hardhaigh Dock, Lv. 2 in the Empire of Mor Ardain, or at the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia. He offers the DLC quest The Lone Watchman.
Malusio is an NPC in . He is an Indoline who can be found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. He is the chief of the Indoline guards.
Mad About Titan Weapons is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Hardhaigh Palace in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It features a conversation between Newt and other characters. __FORCETOC__
Maiden Voyage is a quest in . It can be received from Olua at the Rigitte Waters in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Mailer Runners (Japanese: , Meirā Rannā) are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 28 - 29 in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during Chapter 4.

Maqqa is an NPC in . She is a young Urayan who can be found in the Work Observation Tower of the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain where he must be rescued during the Quest Eternal Spirit. She is the daughter of Dianna.

Making Love Source is a DLC Quest in . It is one of five quests released as downloadable content, the New Quests Pack 3 of the Expansion Pass. It is received from Poppi QT after staying at Lemour Inn in the Argentum Trade Guild.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Marble Cameos (Japanese: , Māburu Kameo) are DLC accessories in . They increase the amount of HP recovered by the wearer when healed by up to 24%. They are the upgraded version of the Shell Cameo accessory. These accessories affect the healing effects provided by Recovery-type and Defensive-type Arts, revivals and the special healing granted by some other other accessories and Blade Skills, but will not impact HP recovered from HP Potions. For accessories that affect the healing effect of HP Potions, check the Activity Amulet, Healing Amulet and Rebirth Amulet. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Cha

Marching Tirkin (Japanese: , Māchingu Tākin) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family fought at level 96 during Wave 5 of the Challenge Battle Humanoid Alliance. This enemy drops no items.

Major-General Barnaby (Japanese: , Tōshō Barumosu) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . He is a member of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 115 during Humanoid Alliance, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.
Marat is an NPC in . She is an Urayan and can be found in Fonsa Myma near Aquaneze Cosmetics.
Marcel is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found in the Royal Audience Hall in the Kingdom of Tantal. He gives the DLC Blade Quest Corvin's Approach.
Magra Quadwings (Japanese: , Magia Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family and can be found during the day at level 2 in Lasaria Woodland in the Kingdom of Torna.

Marna Garaffas (Japanese: , Māma Girafe) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Garaffa family and can be found at level 40-42 at Loftin Nature Preserve in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. They only appear during the day, replacing the Astle Ellook that appear at night. Three must be defeated to unlock Mythra's level 5 Twilight Striker Blade Special.

Maramal Piranhax (Japanese: , Maremari Samon) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family, and can be found at level 32-39 at Coolley Lake, Duelists' Bridge, Nebley Wind Cave in Gormott. Three must be defeated to unlock Brighid's level 5 Beltane Blade Blade Special.
Manning the Gates is a quest in . It can be received from Carnelian near the Auresco, Main Gate in the Kingdom of Torna.
Making Up the Numbers is a quest in . It can be received from Vronka near the Aletta Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna.

Macmac is an NPC in . She is a Nopon vigilante who can first be found at Yanchik Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna, from which she is coordinating a search for illegal Red Pollen Orbs hidden around Torna and Gormott in green barrels. She gives the quest A Rare Sense of Justice, and her Community is gained upon its completion alongside those of Morumo and Popolo.

Marena is an NPC in . She is a Tornan mother who can be found near the Auresco, Rear Gate in the Kingdom of Torna. Freja is her daughter, and her ill health concerns Marena a great deal. She gives the quest Community Spirit, and her Community is gained alongside Freja's upon its completion. At the end of the quest, she also gives Addam a jar of Energy Pickles to give to his wife.

Maquilla is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian helmsman who can be found first at Yanchik Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna, and then at Lascham Cove in Gormott. She involved during the quest Community Spirit, and her Community is gained alongside that of Aquin and Arb upon completion of Planning for the Future.
Marla is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Human and is encountered dying at Sylvalum's Hilal Stronghold during Reporting for Duty.
Marquis Odesh (Japanese: , Tōryō no Odoshi) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 74 at the north-east area of Clear Sky Bluff on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Making Plans (Japanese: , Dreams) is a Quiet Moment in . It is located at Agni's Birthplace on the Bionis' Shoulder, between Melia and Kino, once the Deinos Sauros is defeated.
MAGDALENE 16 (Japanese: ) is T-elos's Level II Blade Special in .
Maestro Artistry is a light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. It can be found inside a Giants' Trove at Tranquil Tarn.
Madcap Stoppers are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are blockers wielded by Nene.
Madcap Stoppers S are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are blockers wielded by Nene.
Madcap Stoppers R are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are blockers wielded by Nene.
Maktha Wildwood (Japanese: , Morukuna dai shinrin) is a point of interest in .
Mant Ories are normal enemies in . They are members of the Ories family, and can be found at level 55 on Captocorn Peak, northwest of the Tsang Camp.
Manana's Battle Soups are meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients.
Machine Assassin (Japanese: , Mashin'asashin) is a Kevesi Attacker class in .
Magglia Lake (Japanese: , Maguria-ko) is a Landmark in , located in Ribbi Flats.
The Main Castle Gate (Japanese: , Kyassuru: Seimon) is a Landmark in . It is the front entrance of Keves Castle, accessed from Fort O'Virbus.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Mallow-o'-the-Marsh are Mushroom Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Fornis Region in . They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found in Vermilion Woods in . Three are needed for the Vermilion Woods Collectopaedia. Taion reveals that this mushroom can be used for making tea during a discussion with Graziana in Colony Tau, and while pungent, the tea is said to make a person stronger.
Magitech Cores are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Marrin Bones are items in . They can be dropped by Ossyan Marrin near Second Pillar Remnant in the Cadensia Region or Eclipse Marrin near Raptor Perch in the Fornis Region.

Manana Doodlenoodles are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. Two Silver Nopon Coins can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It is unlocked by completing Happiness.

Manana's Battle Soup DXs are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. Two Silver Nopon Coins can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It is unlocked automatically after obtaining a Transcendent Tenderloin.
Machinok Bunnits are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 45 on the Great Sword's Hilt.
Magbow Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 45 & 72 in Erythia Sea.
Magranger Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 97-98 at the Emerald Font in Erythia Sea.
Mammon Quarduns are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Quardun family, and can be found at level 63-64 throughout Erythia Sea.
Mammon Quarmus are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Quarmu family, and can be found at level 61-62 in Erythia Sea.

Marlon is an NPC in . She was part of Lenny's squad alongside Olivia-Anne and Jango before being killed by monsters in Yzana Plains. Noah sends her and her fallen comrades off during the quest Farewell Melody. __NOTOC__

Manana's Miso Soups are meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It is unlocked after completing Triton's Ascension Quest, My Memories.
Manana's Nibblekibble is a Key Item in . It is made by Manana using two Thick Ories Shanks at the Ladras Camp on Captocorn Peak during The Big, Unseen Monster.
Maktha Ever-Greens are Meal items in . They can be purchased from the Colony Tau Canteen. Purchasing it for the first time unlocks the Well-Dressed Maktha Salad recipe for Manana's Menu.

Maroking Marrin is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 65 at Limoux Hill in the Dannagh Desert during Happiness; however, it also respawns after the quest. During Happiness, it drops Lucky Marrin Thickcuts.
Magnificent Fist (Japanese: , Gurētonakkuru, "Great Knuckle") is a Battle Art in . It is an art exclusive to Triton.
Majestic Zone is a Battle Art in . It is one of Masha's arts as a Hero.
Machine Clap is one of Nikol's arts in . It becomes unlockable after defeating the Ritteli Rhinon at the Echoes of Gran Dell Citadel.

Magwall Road (Japanese: , Mākuwōru Kaidō) is a location in , located on The Ragmos Desolation. It is a road between the Fallen Gate of Ulcaria and Raguel Bridge. The Unique Monster Naberius Invictus can be found here.

Many-Lived Derrick (Japanese: , Tensei no Rongikepusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Taos family, and can be found at level 42 above the Gelgemos Garrison on the The Ragmos Desolation. It hatches from the Taos Egg.
Marnuck Avengers are enemies in . They are Marnuck soldiers, and can be found at level 50-57 at Shabik's Branch, the Ochus Corridor, and the Sacred Perses in Volitaris.
The Marnuck Worshipper is a Story Exclusive Enemy in . It is a Marnuck soldier that is fought at level 53 at the Lakeview Stronghold in Noctilum during Chapter 13 (Act 2).
The Maintenance Wear I is a casual full body armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Mask I.
The Maintenance Wear II is a Casual Wear full body armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Mask II.
The Maintenance Wear III is a casual full body armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Mask III.
The Maintenance Wear IV is a casual full body armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Mask IV.
Maintenance Wear may refer to: * Maintenance Wear I * Maintenance Wear II * Maintenance Wear III * Maintenance Wear IV
Maintenance Mask may refer to: *Maintenance Mask I *Maintenance Mask II *Maintenance Mask III *Maintenance Mask IV
The Maintenance Mask I is a Casual Wear head armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Wear I.
The Maintenance Mask II is a Casual Wear head armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Wear II.
The Maintenance Mask III is a Casual Wear head armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Wear III.
The Maintenance Mask IV is a Casual Wear head armor in . It forms a set with the Maintenance Wear IV.
Magomago is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found outside of Anastatia's in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Melia Antiqua (Japanese: , Meria Enshento, Melia Ancient; English dub: in XC: , in XC3: ) is one of the main playable characters in and is part of the High Entia race.

Mechonis (Japanese: , Kishin, lit. Machine-God; English dub: or ) is a titan in . It is the mechanical counterpart to the Bionis, and home to the Mechon and the Machina. Mechonis is locked in an ancient feud with Bionis.

Mechon (Japanese: , Kishinhei, lit. Machine-God Soldiers, Mechonis Soldiers; English dub: ) are a "race" of mechanical beings who reside on Mechonis in , and are constantly at war with the Homs on Bionis. It is unclear what their overall intentions are, but they are a serious threat to anyone unable to wield the Monado or an anti-Mechon weapon, as Mechon are impervious to almost all attacks. Unless otherwise stated, Mechon are generally Sight and Species enemies.

Mechon M63 are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are Mechon, and four are fought at level 20 in Sword Valley during the Prologue. They also appear at level 6 in the Commercial District, Military District, Residential District, and outside the Main Entrance of Colony 9 during the Mechon attack, with one being fought outside of Dunban's House.

Mechon M69 are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are Mechon that are fought at level 24 in Sword Valley during the Prologue, at level 6 in the Commercial District, Residential District, Military District, and by the Main Entrance of Colony 9 during the Mechon raid, and at level 5 in the Central Plaza during a story event.

The Mechon M71 (Japanese: , Nanajūichishiki Kishinhei) is a boss in . It is a Mechon, and is fought at level 18 in Spiral Valley on Bionis' Leg. It is commonly referred to as the Tentacled Mechon. This small creature manipulates about a dozen tentacles both to move about and attack. It is a servant under Xord who was going to collect, and likely eat, Sharla and Juju after it captured them.

Mechon M53X (Japanese: , Gojūsanshiki Kishinpei: Kai) are enemies in . They are enhanced Mechon units, and are upgraded versions of the Mechon M69 models, and can be found at level 15 along Maguel Road on Bionis' Leg. They drop Generic Blades, which are needed as part of Materials for a Mixer. Variants of the Mechon M53X appear in the Ether Mine, a normal one and a story exclusive one, and outside, in the Colony 6, a story exclusive one, at different levels and with different drops.

Mass-Produced Faces (Japanese: , Ryōsangata Feisu) are Faced Mechon in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are duplicates of the original Xord, and the probable fate of most Homs who are converted to Face Mechon. Mass-Produced Faces are first encountered by the party outside the Freight Elevator in Colony 6, and first fought by the party at Sword Valley.

Mementos of a Lost Son (Japanese: , Musuko no Katami) is a quest in . This quest can be received from Cheryl, northeast of the Commercial District, once Tephra Cave is accessible after the Mechon attack Colony 9. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment and tell Cheryl she can count on him.

Mechon M55 (Japanese: , Gojūgoshiki Kishinhei) are enemies in . They are Mechon and appear at level 19 – 22 in the Ether Mine, specifically on the east platform of Central Pit - Level 2 and near the ether deposits on the north and south sides; on the west and northeast sides of Central Pit - Level 3; and at the ether deposit near Personnel Lift 3 on Central Pit - Level 3. These areas become inaccessible after using the Freight Elevator to leave the ether mine. There is a Story Exclusive variant in the Central Pit - Base Level of the Ether Mine. It is fought at level 21 during the battle against Xord.
Mefimefi (Japanese: ) is a Nopon in . She can be found in the middle of the Military District of Colony 9, and upstairs in Colony 6, south of the Heart-to-Heart upstairs near the entrance.
Medi (Japanese: ) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. He is one of the two village doctors, and can be found near the weapon shop at Kyn Shopping Street in Frontier Village.

Mechon M72 are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are Mechon that are fought at level 20 in Sword Valley during the Prologue, and later at level 5 in the Commercial District, Residential District, Military District, and just outside the Main Entrance of Colony 9. One Mechon M72 unit is fought at level 5 in the Central Plaza while another is fought at level 6 at Colony 9's Main Entrance. These variants do not drop any Treasure Chests.

Mechon M82 (Japanese: , Hachijūnishiki Kishinpei) are Mechon in . They appear at level 8 during the Mechon raid on Colony 9, in the Commercial District and outside the Main Entrance. They respawn but only during this raid attack in Colony 9. There are four other versions of this Mechon M82. In Colony 9, a story exclusive variant is fought during the second story event battle at Central Plaza, and another story exclusive variant is fought during the third story event battle at the Main Entrance. In the Ether Mine, a normal variant is encountered. A special variant is a Boss fought during the prologue event in Sword Valley.

Matryona (Japanese: , Matoryōna) is a Homs in Xenoblade Chronicles. She is an artist who can be found in the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg between 9:00 and 18:00. After everyone in the Refugee Camp has been moved back to Colony 6, she can be found near the Reconstruction HQ, or near Colony 6's Main Entrance, between 21:00 and 6:00. She is an artist who has a crush on Ewan and wants to be with him.

The Mechon M51 (Japanese: , Gojūichishiki Kishinpei) is a story exclusive enemy in . It is a type of Mechon that appears during the raid in Colony 9. It can be found at level 5 at the Central Plaza during the first round of the second story event battle. It is similar in appearance to Mechon M69. This enemy drops no chests.

The Mechon M42 is a story exclusive Mechon in . It appears at level 5 during the Mechon raid on Colony 9. It is fought only during the third story event battle at the Main Entrance. It does not drop any Treasure Chest, does not grant any EXP or AP for defeating them. There is another story exclusive variant in the Ether Mine only fought during the battle to rescue Otharon at the Storage Depot.

Mell Lizards (Japanese: , Merudo Rizado, English dub: ) are enemies in . They are members of the Lizard family, and can be found northeast from the Mag Mell Ruins in Tephra Cave. They are brown and have red spots. Five of them must be defeated to complete Colony 9's Monster Quest 4 - Part 3.

Meaty Potatoes (Japanese: , Furesshu Meron, Flesh Melon) are collectables in . They can be found in Central Factory and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they are more like a meat than a potato and they feel like someone's eating a meatball.

Meaty Carrots (Japanese: , Mīto Papurika, Meat Bell Pepper) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, they are so succulent that someone cannot help feeling they are animal flesh and not a vegetable.

Mechonis Field (機神界フィールド, Kishin-kai Fīrudo) is an area in . It is located within the left leg of the Mechonis and is the largest area by sheer size. It is directly connected to the Fallen Arm and the Central Factory. All of the enemies here are Mechon. After the events at the Meyneth Shrine during Chapter 14, Mechonis Field will become inaccessible. All collectables here can be found at Colony 6 after this area becomes unavailable.

The Mechonis Core (Japanese: , Kishin-kai Chūsū) is an area in . It is the final area within Mechonis, and is the place from which Mechonis' movements can be manually controlled. According to Vanea it is located directly above the Apocrypha Generator, which suggests it is in the upper chest or neck of the Mechonis. It is also the smallest area in the entire game.
Material Quest 1 (Japanese: , Sozai Kuesuto 1) is a quest in . It can be received from a Nopon in the Weapon Development Lab in the Military District of Colony 9.
Material Quest 2 (Japanese: , Sozai Kuesuto 2) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs in the Ether Light in the Commercial District of Colony 9.
Material Quest 4 (Japanese: , Sozai Kuesuto 4) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs north of Tranquil Square in the Residential District of Colony 9.
Material Quest 3 (Japanese: , Sozai Kuesuto 3) is a quest in . It can be received from a female Homs near the bridge between the Commercial District and the Central Plaza in Colony 9.

Meeting the Nopon Sage (Japanese: , Sennin ni Deau) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Pipiki in the Central Plaza, west border of the Sacred Altar's pool, in Frontier Village after completing Honouring the Nopon Sage. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment.
Materials for a Mixer (Japanese: , Mikisā no Zairyō Atsume) is a quest in . It is received automatically when Making a Mixer is accepted.
The Mechonis Field Collection is a portion of the Collectopaedia in .

Mat Ices (Japanese: , Matto Aisu) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg. According to their description, they are ice known as Golden Soil and they are also formed underground and gold in colour.

Medium Armour (Japanese: , Chūsōbi) tends towards medium weight and a balance between Ether Def and Physical Def. It can only be worn by characters who have the Medium Equipment skill, or through Skill Links at a cost of 10 Affinity Coins. Shulk, Reyn, Sharla, and Dunban have this skill as soon as they join the party. Medium Armours have three general designs as represented by Hunter, Regnas, and Eryth. All medium equipment shares a general appearance with one of the three, with several colour variants of each.

This quest will expire if Let's Make Fillings! is completed first. Medical Advancements (Japanese: , Chiryō Sōchi wo Kaihatsu) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Medi in the weapon shop at Kyn Shopping Street in Frontier Village. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment. This quest and Let's Make Fillings! are mutually exclusive. After this quest is completed, Npa may offer Healing the Healer and Kofuko may offer World's Strongest Flavour.

Medicinal Brog Oil is a rare material in . It can be dropped by Cute Brogs at night in Colony 9, or traded for. According to their description, a single application of them eases back pain and side effects include hirsuteness. Two are needed for The Key to a Long Life.

Marsh Flamiis (Japanese: , Māshu Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 23 in Satorl Marsh anytime but with no fog. They are very similar to Satorl Flamiis. Both share the Kick Rush and Binding Screech Arts. They can drop the Twin Flamii Eggs needed for Preventing Starvation.

The Mechon Wreckage Site (Japanese: , Kishinhei Zangai Atochi) is a landmark in . It is located in Colony 9, and the is first location visited in the game. After finishing the Battle of Sword Valley section of the game as Dunban, the main story of begins here, with Shulk searching for scrap metal from all the Mechon debris so he can make new weapons and armour. This is the first time Shulk is playable. Reyn appears and helps him fight a Krabble, which was using some of the debris as its shell. Then they fight a Caterpile. After these battles, they head back to Colony 9. There is a Heart-to-Heart - "A Heropon's Perspective" - located here between Sharla and Riki, and Werner can be found here,

The Medicinal Herb is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be found at the end of the cliff from south end of Raguel Bridge - North, and just east above Tranquil Grotto, and is needed for Spirits Raised.

Maternal Armu Milk are rare materials in . It can only be dropped by the Armus on Agora Shore in Colony 9, or traded for with Zukazu before completing A Big Brother's Fight. According to their description, they are nutritious, delicious and go great on breakfast cereal. Three are needed for Thawing Relations.
Mend the Plant (Japanese: , Puranto wo Shūriseyo) is a quest in . It is automatically received when Trouble at the Plant is accepted from Jarack at the Ether Plant in the Eryth Sea.

Meditor Gnashers (Japanese: , Meisō no Tsukutsuku) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are biters that can be wielded by Riki. They can be acquired by trading with Peppino or Nopo'rikh whom can be found in Colony 6. It can also be received as a quest reward.

Mechonis Swords (Japanese: , Kishin Sōken) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Fiora's initial twin blades, which she is equipped with when she rejoins the party on the Fallen Arm. They cannot be acquired from any other source.

Mechon M64 (Japanese: , Rokujūyonshiki Kishinpei) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 16 on Bionis' Leg in the plain northwest of Raguel Bridge - South Landmark or east of Raguel Bridge - North Landmark on a cliff along Maguel Road. Five of them must be defeated as part of Bionis' Leg's Monster Quest 3 - Part 1. They can drop Generic Shafts which are required for Materials for a Mixer.

Mechon M53 (Japanese: , Gojūsanshiki Kishinpei) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 14 along the plain southwest of Raguel Lake on Bionis' Leg. They drop the item Generic Blade, that is required to make the mixer in Materials for a Mixer.
The Mauk Floodgate (Japanese: , Mōku Suimon) is a location in . It is located in Satorl Marsh. Beyond the floodgate are the Sororal Statues.

Meditative Varla (Japanese: , Meisō no Wapura) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 65 near the Telethia Bridge on the second floor in Agniratha. Defeating Meditative Varla is the objective of the quest Military Status 2 - 1.

Mending Memories (Japanese: , Kowareta Omoide no Shūfuku) is a quest in . It can be received by Mixik near the Junks on the Fallen Arm. Accepting this quest also triggers Resolution - Father and Resolution - Mother, they must be completed in order to finish Mending Memories. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

Matryona's Answer (Japanese: , Matoryōna no Hentō) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Matryona in Colony 6 after completing What is Courage?!. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

Melfica Road (Japanese: , Merufika-dōri) is a location in . It is one of the three moving sidewalks in Alcamoth. It begins at the Main Entrance and ends in front of the Imperial Palace. It connects the ground floor with the first floor, and there is a shop here.
Mellow Sardis (Japanese: , Merou Sādi) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Sardi family, and can be found at level 15 near Kasharpa Falls on Bionis' Leg.
Mechon M32 (Japanese: , Sanjūnishiki Kishinpei) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on at level 15 near Raguel Bridge - South and Maguel Road on Bionis' Leg.

Melancholy Tyrea (Japanese: , Yūutsu no Taruko) is a Surprise Quest in . It is triggered between Watchpoint Junction and Hope Farm in Colony 6. It is the only quest in the game to feature fully voiced cutscenes. The third objective of the quest involves the boss battle against the Mysterious Telethia at the Lakeside and requires the party to defeat it. The events of this quest are referenced during .

Mechon M32X are Mechon normal enemies in . They can be found at level 18 – 21 in the Ether Mine in the tunnels between Test Pit 1 and 3 or near Test Pit 4, and on Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 of the Central Pit. A Story Exclusive variant which appears during story events carries no treasure.
Materia Krabbles (Japanese: , Materia Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found at levels 21-23 near Glowmoss Lake in the Ether Mine.

Mechon M67 are Mechon enemies in . They can be found at level 20 - 23 near some of the Ether Crystal deposits at Central Pit - Level 2 in the Ether Mine which becomes inaccessible after using the Freight Elevator to leave the mine. There is a Story Exclusive variant in the Central Pit - Base Level of the Ether Mine, it is fought at level 21 during the battle against Xord.

Mechon Tentacles (Japanese: , Kishinhei Shokushu) are Mechon story exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are encountered during the first boss battle against the Mechon M71 in Spiral Valley on Bionis' Leg.
Mechon M78 Flex+ (Japanese: , Nanajūhachishiki Kishinhei: Yawa) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 47 in Sword Valley in the Ether Storage Area.

Mechon M46X (Japanese: , Yonjūrokushiki Kishinhei: Kai) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon, and can be found at level 55 on the Fallen Arm between the knuckle of Digit 2 and the Connecting Bridge.

Mechon M64 Armour+ (Japanese: , Shinsōkō Rokujūyonshiki Kishinhei) are Mechon quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 32 near the Freight Elevator near Colony 6 during the quest Defend Colony 6 - Mechon, which requires the party to defeat them.

Mechon M84 (Japanese: , Hachijūyonshiki Kishinhei) are three story exclusive Mechon in . They can be found in the Ether Mine during two story event battles, appearing from arms along the mine's central engine on the B3F. These Mechon M84 are one of the few story exclusive enemies that exceptionally drop Treasure Chests. One is fought at level 24 on the northern platform, reached by using the propeller system on the initial eastern platform when arriving from the Personnel Lift 3. The engine's arm blocks the access to the ice Ether Crystals deposit. Two are fought at level 23 and 24 on the western platform, reached by using the propeller system on the northern platform. The Merchant's Gift is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Finding it is the objective of Search Quest 3 in Alcamoth. It can be found far to the east of Alcamoth's Main Entrance. Keep going until the end.

Memory 925 Pieces are Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles. There are four of them scattered around Mechonis Field, and they must be collected to complete The History of Mechonis. The first Memory 925 Piece can be found on the ground floor of Mechonis Field. It is reached via a climbable wall southeast of the first conveyor. The second Memory 925 Piece can be found on level 1F, southeast from the 2nd Lift - 1F. It can be reached via a climbable ledge on the east side of the map. The third Memory 925 Piece can be found on level 3F in the Ether Gear Store. The fourth Memory 925 Piece is also on level 3F, but its location is only accessible from 4F. Memory 903 is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Obtaining it is the objective of The History of the Capital. It can be found in the Judicial District of Agniratha, on a ledge containing several fossilized Telethia.

Materials for a Bomb (Japanese: , Bakudan no Zairyō wo Atsumero) is a Story Quest in . It is received automatically during the second objective of the story quest Find a Path to the Top while arriving at the in Central Factory.

The Mechon Factory (Japanese: , Kishinpei Seisan Kōjō) is a location in . It is located on the third floor of the Central Factory. The quest Find a Path to the Top requires infiltrating this factory, which triggers Daring Assault, requiring the party to defeat the M96 Crisis Unit, along with two Crisis Response Units.
This page is a list of all the Unique Monsters in Mechonis Field.
Melia's Imperial Villa (Japanese: , Meria no Rikyū nite) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in the Imperial Villa in Alcamoth, between Fiora and Melia at green affinity.
Mastermind (known as Elite Planner in the Japanese version) is a Class featured in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of six final classes and can only be leveled up from Psycorruptor.

Mediators is a division within BLADE. This division is known as Companion (Japanese: , Konpanion) in the Japanese version. They aim to resolve problems between citizens of New Los Angeles, including breaking up fights and finding lost cats. Mediators receive increased Division Points from completing missions and training scouted BLADEs. Receiving division support from Mediators grants TP Support, which grants extra TP from using Arts.

Mechanical Rhythm (機の律動) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 15 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard whenever the party engages an enemy in battle in the Mechonis areas of the game (except for Sword Valley): Galahad Fortress, Fallen Arm, Mechonis Field, Central Factory, and Agniratha. Notably, this same theme plays when Junks flies the party into the Central Factory to pursue Egil after the destruction of Agniratha. A motif from this song is used in "New Battle!!!" in . A shortened version of this song appears in and , where it has a chance of playing on the two stages, Gaur Plain and the Cloud Sea of Alrest. It can also play on F

Mastema is a Heavy Type based Skell unit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Mastema is one of the Skells manufactured by BLADE in New Los Angeles. The Mastema's vehicular form is a sort of futuristic multi-legged and seemingly-amphibious vehicle. The level 60 upgrade of this Skell is the Mastema White Reaper.

Memory's End (記憶の果て…, The End of Memories...) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 23 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard while the party is in Memory Space, on their way to the final battle with Zanza. This song is reused in , where it plays in Alcamoth.

Melancholia is a track in composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano with original lyrics by mpi and David Whitaker, vocals provided by Aimee Blackschleger, and rap provided by David Whitaker that originally first appeared in Hiroyuki Sawano's 2009 album musica. It was rearranged for its release in the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, listed as "Melancholia " on the Japanese Society for Rights of Authors, Composers and Publishers (JASRAC) database. It is track 6 of disc 3 in the soundtrack. It is a track that plays in the Squad selection menu (in the Wii U version only) as well as during the following cutscenes: * Nagi and Maurice discussing the dangerous indigen during A Day in the Life * The
Master Gunner is one of Yelv's two Signature Arts in . It is obtained upon completion of Yelv's Partner.

Melanya, the Sound Sleeper (Japanese: , Rakune no Merānya) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Suid family. It can be found at level 20 in Oblivia, at the eastern end of Oblivia Ingress. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Melanya, the Sound Sleeper.

Megatonne, the Hell Express (Japanese: , Bōsō Tokkyū Bigguton, lit. Runaway Express Big-ton) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Suid family. It can be found at level 11 in Primordia. It can drop the Suid Fillet needed for the Basic Mission Suid Sirloin.
Mephites (Japanese: , Mepitesu) are skunk-like enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are characterized by their large furry tails and their use of a malodorous gas as a weapon.

May (Japanese: , Mei) is a Human NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the east end of Aaroy Plain. She is member of the Curators Division. After Mayhem, she can be found at the Division Drive in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, in the Reclaimers part on the right of the staircase near Quincy during the day if A route was chosen, or on the staircase during the night if B route was chosen.
Matthew (Japanese: , Mashū) is an NPC in . He can be found just inside the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.
Medicine Man is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a party member is healed by a male character, and is the counterpart to Medicine Woman.
Medicine Woman is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a party member is healed by a female character. It is the counterpart to Medicine Man.
Medic Free is one of many Aura Arts in . It increases the user's Debuff resistance and the user automatically revives once incapacitated.
Master Edge is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Commando at rank 9.
Merciful Scirpos (Japanese: , Māshī Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 51-52 in Noctilum's Weeping Whitewood.

Mathias (English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found near Division Drive in the Administrative District. He works as a junior to Gwin. He is a member of the Curators in BLADE, although he introduces himself as a Mediator. Mathias lives with Aisha (English dub: ), the only living non-Mimeosome domestic cat on Mira. Aisha is also registered in BLADE as a member of the Harriers' Tyrant-hunting division.
Mephite Mayhem is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Interceptors and the primary destination is Oblivia. It is a request to defeat six Stray Mephites.
Maxim is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found on West Melville Street in the Commercial District in New Los Angeles.
May May (Japanese: , Myēmyē) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Ma-non, and can be found at the Starboard inside the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

The Matinal Evellos (Japanese: , Ārī Sutorutto, Early Evello) are four Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Evello family, and are fought at level 11 at Grieving Plains in Primordia during Renewed Will.

Meditation Powders (Japanese: , Zazen Paudā) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular near Talon Rock Second Terrane. Two units are needed for The Bug Whisperer.
Medusa Squids (Japanese: , Medyusaika) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.

Mega Muscle Builders (Japanese: , Chō Kin'niku Ekisupaudā) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular around FN Site 515. Twelve are needed for A Revised Regimen.
Medicinal Blatta Oils are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Blattas in Primordia.
Meaty Evello Eggs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Evellos in Primordia. Three are needed for Can't Make an Omelet….

Marry Me! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Cedric and the primary destination is the Residential District of New Los Angeles. Accepting this mission is a prerequisite for Hope Springs Eternal.

Meeting Yelv (Japanese: , Ieruvu to no Deai) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received near North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. Completing this mission unlocks Yelv as a recruitable character.
Mayday (Japanese: , Koritsusuru Ippikiōkami) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from May near the Ruins on the Butte in Oblivia.
Mayhem (Japanese: , Kyōryokusuru Ippikiōkami) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from May near the Ruins on the Butte in Oblivia.

Mega Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Mega Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family, and can be found at level 53-60 at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum. They are all Hidden Enemies.

The Mastema White Reaper is a Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the level 60 version of the Mastema skell and becomes available after completing Chapter 12. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.
Mephite Ear Hairs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Mephites.

The Menacing Marnuck (Japanese: , Menesu Marunāku) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Marnuck Ganglion and appears at level 34 at the Bedrock Hold in Primordia. Defeating it is required during the Affinity Mission Blitzkrieg.
Master Pugiliths (Japanese: , Masutā Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 55 around Oblivia's Cliffside Camp.
Mephite Stinkbags are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Mephites.

|-|Sylvalum = |-|Jeffrey = Med Kits are Important Items in . Five must be collected for one route of A Challenger Approaches. They can be found either in the storage supply room in Sylvalum's Hilal Stronghold, either from Jeffrey in front of the Restricted Hangar Entrance in the Administrative District.
Mechanoid Slayer is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Blast Fencer at rank 3.
Max GP Drive is a ground Armor Skell Augment in and . It increases the maximum GP value for a Skell.
Max HP Drive is a ground armor Skell augment in and . It increases the Hit Points for a Skell by 1% to 20%.
Max HP Up is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It raises the Hit Points by a fixed amount for the party member. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.HP.Max.
Max TP Up is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It raises the Tension Point maximum by a fixed amount for a party member.
Max HP Boost is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It raises the Hit Points by a fixed percentage for the party member.
Max TP Boost is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It raises the Tension Point maximum by a fixed percentage for a party member.
Material Hunt A is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from L automatically upon accepting his Affinity Mission L's Conundrum.
Martin is a NPC in . He can be found at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum. He is a member of the Interceptors division. He is actually Dale Gibbon, the killer of Murderess's parents.
The Meal Ticket is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from Camber and is needed to complete Trade Agreement.
The Massive Ring Fragment is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Solan asks the party to obtain it during A Great Divide.
Material Hunt B is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from L automatically upon accepting his Affinity Mission L's Conundrum.
Material Hunt C is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from L automatically upon accepting his Affinity Mission L's Conundrum.
Megajolt Rattle and Roll is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Meredith & Co. and the primary destination is Cauldros.

Melee Attack Probes are types of Data Probes in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They boost melee attack of nearby party members and Skells. One is obtained as a reward from Hugo after completing his mission, Data Probe Progress. Another can be found in a White Whale debris on a roof rock, above Primordia's Seaswept Ridge. However, this wreckage requires the maximum Mechanical Field-Skill level. Lastly, a third one can be found in a cavern deep within the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros. The cavern is occupied by a Definian Clone and a Lost Caro.
Megaflame-B is a superweapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is known as Flame-Assault in the Japanese version.
